comparison.objective: Remove and recover four HELICOIL tangs; record snaps a lid around a full hot-drink cup rim.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses a precision mandrel and hammer, then manipulates tiny fragments; record supports a compliant cup while progressively pressing a lid around its circumference.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures, contained tangs, retained inserts, and no damage; record requires complete rim engagement without tipping, squeezing, spilling, or unsafe release. Candidate fracture/damage tolerances are not numeric.
comparison.reason: Progressive snap-fit closure on a crushable filled cup does not test impact-driven fracture or fragment recovery.
